newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares expected to maintain firm tone.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares expected to maintain firm tone.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to maintain their firm tone on Wednesday.
"There is certainly more interest. But I expect there will also be some profit taking as people are still worried about the Dow in the longer term," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
Dealers said attention would continue to be on newly listed Singapore issues which would have more room for gains given their recent subdued performance.
On Tuesday the Straits Times Industrial index closed off its highs at 2,055.68, up 27.08 points on Monday.
